model: OMEGA Speedmaster Silver Snoopy Award 50th Anniversary Co-Axial Master Chronometer Chronograph 42 mm 310.32.42.50.02.001 (42 mm steel, white / silver dial with blue sub-dials and the Snoopy engraving, blue tachymeter bezel, blue nylon strap, chronograph)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). Follower of the Omega Moonwatch template (config/watches/omega-moonwatch-31030425001001.json, untouched): the same structure (one tachymeter bezel ring without coin ring, baton hands with lume strips, three sub-dials with hands and hubs, fluted crown with a domed cap, two chronograph pushers with their own origins and angles, asymmetric twisted lugs carried by the alpha silhouette) built by pipeline/steps/watch_omega_snoopy.py (copy of watch_omega_moonwatch.py with a one-piece NYLON strap = `strap_photo` material, a hub centred on the photographed dome and the chrono seconds hand as free polygons). Every number is measured again on the Snoopy photo (see the measure file): this render has another scale and perspective than the Moonwatch one (12.87 px/mm, bezel top 257.26 px, pushers about 8 percent thicker).

case.note: integrated twisted lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (lug tops y 158.6, bottoms y 773.5 px = 47.78 mm, tip_top 23.0 + tip_bottom 24.75 = 47.75); the crown / pusher rows take the straight shoulder line (right_override_px), the guard shoulders stay in the silhouette; top and bottom slope toward the strap; notch: the gap between the strap end (y 19.5 top, -20.87 bottom) and the bezel is background in the photo (alpha 0) between the lug inner edges (x -9.94 .. 10.31 top, -9.97 .. 10.29 bottom) and is cut out of the case slab down to the steel case ring circle (r 264.5 px = 20.5 mm about the ring centre)

bezel.note: one blue ring: wide silver inner chamfer bezel_in .. chamfer_to (steel look in the photo), flat blue top to bezel_out (insert_out = bezel_out: no steel coin ring); numerals, dots and TACHYMETRE are photo texture

hands.note: profile hands (hour, minute) = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, measured about the least-squares pivot: hour baton half width 6.0 px to s 115.5 then a pointed tip to 124.3, minute 4.8 px to s 175.5 then an arrow tip to 184.3, lume = white strips (hour s 25..107.5 half 2.4 px, minute s 53.5..170.5 half 2.0 px). The chrono seconds hand is free polygons (hands.polygons): tail + shaft (half 6.0 px at the tail end s -52 to 3.3 px), lume diamond (kite, s 99.9 .. 132.3) and needle to s 194.5. Sub-dial hands are polygons over hubs (hands.discs). Hands / hubs use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front).

crown.note: fluted barrel x 774.0..807.4 px (r 43.15 px, centre y 461.5) with a domed Omega cap to x 814.2; the housing shoulders above and below (x 790.3) stay in the silhouette (right_override_px rows 417.5..505.5)

pushers.note: two chronograph pushers (cylindrical buttons with a rounded end face), axes at +24.44 / -24.85 deg from their own origin points on the crown side (the axes do not meet: camera tilt), end faces 306.9 / 310.5 px from the origins, button radii 32.83 / 32.98 px, neck 13 px; measured in axis-aligned views of the silhouette

strap.note: strap.kind nylon: one-piece blue nylon strap (columns ['strap']); pieces from the visible strap end at the case (y 19.5 top, -20.87 bottom; the bezel overlaps it at the centre) to the strap ends at the image borders (alpha rows 1 and 1023, the silhouette narrows from 20.7 mm at the lugs to about 8 mm at the ends); the weave, the lighter edge stitching and the shading at the lugs are the projected photo (strap_photo: emission / roughness 0.8 / specular 0), flat, no relief

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
